nina (Partnerships): Heads-up: Im drafting a nimble credit-bridge playbook for marketplace offers that bundle cloud marketplace listing + HW partner rebates + SI activation credits. Want quick takes on commit floors, discount depth, and announcement cadence.
raj (Sales): Short answer: this could be our quickest POC-to-paid lever. Need commit floors mapped to AE quota. Also, keep an escape for enterprise direct deals.
hannah (Product): Two UX calls: 1) clearly label "Intro (limited)" vs "Standard" price rows, 2) expose renewal guidance and conversion incentives in the listing tooltip. Also flag capacity SKU mapping if HW rebate redeems to Dedicated.
omar (Finance): Financial guardrails: onboarding credits treated as contra-revenue and amortized over the committed term. If we pay credits up-front, proration rules required. Ill model ARR impact under low/med/high churn.
nina (Partnerships): Draft offer structure (proposal): ```
- INTRO (60d): 32% off list, $12k min commit, onboarding credit $3k one-time. SI activation credit $1k (post-checklist).
- COMMIT (12mo): 18% off list, annual true-up, onboarding credit $1k, HW rebate up to $7k redeemable only for Reserved/Dedicated capacity SKU purchases.
RULES: credits do NOT stack; highest applicable credit applies. SI credit requires signed integration checklist within 45 days. HW rebate redemption requires mapped capacity SKU and proof of purchase.
RENEWAL INCENTIVES: Renew >=100% commit -> discount reduces by 7ppt next year; Renew >=110% -> extend current discount by 3ppt. Convert to Dedicated within 180d -> return 50% of onboarding credit as capacity credit.```
leila (Solutions): SI checklist draft: integration runbook, test harness pass, deployment notes, single concisely scoped deliverable + co-marketing blurb. Ill prep the checklist.
ops (Eng): Ops checklist: staging pricing mask, entitlement flag, billing-hook smoke tests, telemetry for credit redemptions and SKU mapping. I can validate the flow Wed morning.
legal (Legal): Marketing LOA needs 8 business days pre-announce; partner quote signoff window 3 business days. Will push a template to the shared drive.
marketing-bot: Saved content: https://redwood.docs/marketplace/nimble-credit-templates (owner: marketing).
raj (Sales): HW rebate funding idea: 10% co-sell margin pool + 5% reserve for churn adjustments. Make rebate redeemable only when customer buys Reserved/Dedicated SKU to avoid cross-subsidizing hosted usage.
omar (Finance): Action: Ill run ARR scenarios and revenue recognition note by Thu COB. Also will cap total credits per account and show impact on net ARR.
hannah (Product): Action: Ill add UI copy + FAQ and ensure the listing displays "Intro price" and "Renewal guidance".
nina (Partnerships): Launch timeline suggestion: T-5w assets drafted, T-3w LOA signed, T-2w SI enablement + ops validation, T-1w legal signoff, public announce. Action owners: Nina final playbook (Tue), Omar ARR + rev-rec (Thu), Leila SI checklist (Fri), Ops sandbox validation (Wed), Legal LOA template (Tue). Any objections? :rocket:
